This app was made by Hamidreza Rahimi with help from AI.

VisionAssistant uses a photo taken or chosen from the phone and, with the help of AI, describes the surroundings, objects and obstacles in it for a blind user. After getting a description, you can ask more questions about the same photo.

To start a new conversation, first add an image with the Attachments button. A screen opens where you can either take a photo with the camera or choose a file from the phone. Second, if you like, type a question about the image in the box at the top; if you leave it empty, the app describes the surroundings by default. Third, press Send to get a reply.

After the first reply, you can type more questions about the same image in the same box and press Send again. Each question and each reply is shown as a separate item in the conversation list.

To keep a conversation, press the Save conversation button. After saving, the app is ready for a new conversation. Saved conversations are available from the Menu button under Recent conversations.

On a saved conversation's screen, you can double-tap any part of it to select it. If you type a new question or attach a new image and press Send, only the selected parts are sent along with the question to the main screen, and the conversation continues from there.

From the Menu button and Settings, you can set the app language and the AI service in use, including its endpoint, model name and access keys.
